subject: Sunridge: request for key usage sampling and retention scrub proof
messages:
From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@sunridge.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: security-questions@sunridge.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KMS sampling and retention scrub - Sunridge Prod tenant

Hi Hannah,

As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we need a short sample package for the following:
- 7-day key usage sample for tenant 'sunridge-prod' (include key_id, operation, timestamp, host region, and caller identity where available)
- retention-scrub run notes showing a recent scrub job run and policy references
- HSM manifest listing model/serial and firmware for any HSMs that held tenant keys in the last 90 days
- list of key rotation timestamps for customer-managed keys in the last 90 days

Can you let me know what you can provide by EOD Monday (2028-07-04)? We will need the sample redacted for customer PII and prefer delivery via your secure Drive link.

Thanks,
Tom Evans
Information Security
Sunridge Financial

------------------------------

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@sunridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS sampling and retention scrub - Sunridge Prod tenant

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the set you requested. High-level plan and constraints below:

Deliverables (scope):
- 7-day CSV sample (redacted tenant IDs, caller principal hashed) — attached as kms_key_usage_sample.csv (rows reduced for sampling)
- HSM manifest with serials and firmware dates — hsm_serial_manifest.txt (redacts internal asset tags)
- Retention scrub runbook and a run log excerpt — retention-scrub-runbook.pdf
- Key rotation table for customer-managed keys in the last 90 days (dates only)

Redaction note: We will hash caller identities and truncate any tokens/ARNs. If you require full, unredacted artifacts for internal audit we need an executed NDA/amendment; please confirm.

Delivery window: initial package by Monday 2028-07-04 17:00 PDT. If you need accelerated delivery, we can provide the CSV and manifest earlier.

Operational questions for you: which transfer method do you prefer — secure Drive link (default), SFTP with key exchange, or one-time encrypted bundle?

Marissa and Connor are looped in to assemble the artifacts.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: kms_key_usage_sample.csv (sample, redacted)

------------------------------

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@sunridge.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jul 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS sampling and retention scrub - Sunridge Prod tenant

Tom — quick technical notes to accompany the package: 

1) HSM manifest: attached is a plaintext manifest with the HSM model, serial, and the most recent firmware applied to devices that served keys for sunridge-prod during the requested window. We redact internal rack/room identifiers; if Sunridge needs the full asset tag mapping we can produce it under MSA/AML scope.

2) Rotation table: we will provide a CSV of rotation timestamps (UTC) with key_id hashes. For customer-managed BYO keys we list the rotation events; for hosted-managed keys we provide rotation cadence and last rotation timestamp.

3) Retention scrub: retention-scrub-runbook.pdf contains the scrub schedule, retention policy references, and a sample run log excerpt. Note the scrub is a two-step process (index prune + key metadata purge) — run logs show both steps and checksum validation.

We will also include a short README that maps the hashed ids to the sample rows and describes the redaction approach.

Would you like HSM attestation metadata (certificate fingerprint, attestation date)? We can include the attestation reference but cannot share hardware vendor attestation blobs without a transfer agreement.

- Marissa
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: hsm_serial_manifest.txt, retention-scrub-runbook.pdf

------------------------------

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@sunridge.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 2 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS sampling and retention scrub - Sunridge Prod tenant

Tom — package uploaded to secure Drive link below. I set permissions to Sunridge security group and added view-only for your auditors. Please confirm receipt.

Secure bundle: https://drive.redwood-demo/internal/sunridge/kms-sampling-20280701
Ticket: HB-3242 (internal) — tracks the artifact prep and redaction mapping.

Files included:
- kms_key_usage_sample.csv (sample 7-day rows, redacted)
- hsm_serial_manifest.txt (model/serial/firmware)
- retention-scrub-runbook.pdf (policy + sample run log)
- README-kms-sample.txt (redaction mapping and method)

If you prefer SFTP transfer, reply with an SFTP username and public key; we will stage a one-time encrypted bundle.

Connor O'Brien
Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: kms_key_usage_sample.csv, hsm_serial_manifest.txt, retention-scrub-runbook.pdf

---

Tom (external) replied offline at 2028-07-02 14:25 UTC acknowledging receipt and requesting the HSM attestation fingerprint be added to the package. We scheduled a quick follow-up call for 2028-07-05 to review artifacts with Sunridge audit team.
